text: A browser agent is software that uses an AI model to operate a web browser toward a goal. You describe the task, and the agent automatically opens the page, navigates, chooses actions, and checks the results before continuing. Agents are especially useful for unpredictable workflows because they can adapt to unexpected changes and recover from errors.
